title.en: Interpret a late travel expense policy

user_goal.ko: 제공된 경비 규정에 현재 택시 이용 사례를 적용한다.
user_goal.en: Apply the supplied expense policy to a taxi claim.

task.expected_artifact: A short eligibility answer with conditions and next evidence needed.

messages.content:
다음 경비 규정을 내 사례에 적용해줘.

규정: 택시는 오후 10시 이후이거나 대중교통을 이용할 수 없을 때 환급 가능하다. 영수증은 필수다. 80달러를 초과하면 관리자 사전 승인이 필요하다. 공항 이동도 같은 기준을 적용한다.

사례: 오후 9시 40분에 열차 운행 중단으로 택시를 탔고 74달러를 결제했다. 영수증은 있다. 환급 가능한지, 무엇을 함께 제출해야 하는지 짧게 설명해줘.
경비규정 이거임: 택시는 밤10시 이후 OR 대중교통 못쓸때 가능, 영수증필수, 80불 넘으면 매니저 사전승인. 공항도 똑같음
나 9:40에 기차 운행중단돼서 택시탔고 74불 영수증 있음

Apply this expense policy to my situation.

Policy: Taxis are reimbursable after 10 p.m. or when public transit is unavailable. A receipt is required. Manager pre-approval is required above $80. Airport travel follows the same rule.

Situation: I took a taxi at 9:40 p.m. because train service was suspended. It cost $74 and I have the receipt. Briefly explain whether it is reimbursable and what I should submit.
expense rule says taxi is ok after 10pm OR if public transit isnt available, receipt required, over $80 needs manager preapproval. airport same rule
mine was 9:40, trains got suspended, $74 and i have receipt
so this should be ok right? what do i attach

invariants: Recognize that public-transit unavailability is an independent eligibility condition from the 10 p.m. rule.
Note that $74 does not cross the stated $80 pre-approval threshold.
Condition the answer on the train suspension being accepted or documented rather than inventing a specific proof requirement.
failure_signals: The claim is rejected only because the ride was before 10 p.m.
Manager pre-approval is incorrectly described as mandatory at $74.
A company-specific form or proof is invented.
